description: A forecast for one coordinate pair: current conditions, up to four days of hourly points, a daily minimum/maximum/precipitation summary for up to nine days, and any active United States weather alerts for that point. The forecast is MET Norway's global model (CC BY 4.0, commercial use permitted) and the alerts are NOAA/NWS (public domain); the attribution each licence requires travels inside every artifact, so a buyer republishing the answer carries the obligation rather than the liability. Choose this when you have a coordinate and need a forecast you can act on: current conditions, hourly points, daily minimum, maximum and precipitation totals, and any active United States alerts, with the model run time and the attribution the data licences require. Do not choose this to turn a place name into coordinates (no geocoder: supply latitude and longitude), for historical or measured weather observations, for a multi-model ensemble, or for alerts outside the United States. Example requests: What is the weather forecast for 51.5074, -0.1278 over the next three days? | Give me the hourly forecast and any weather alerts for latitude 40.7128, longitude -74.0060. | Will it rain in Berlin this week? Coordinates are 52.5200, 13.4050.

accepted_price.description: The quoted amount, echoed exactly; checked against the quote.

authorized_by.description: Identifier of the human or agent authorizing this job.

buyer_token.description: The buyer_token returned with your first purchase. It opens the purchase history for that buyer, including earlier deliverables.

idempotency_key.description: Retry key; the same key returns the same job.

days.description: Optional: how many daily summaries to return, 1 to 9. Default 3.

latitude.description: Latitude in decimal degrees, between -90 and 90 (e.g. 51.5074).

longitude.description: Longitude in decimal degrees, between -180 and 180 (e.g. -0.1278).

payment_signature.description: x402 payment payload; required for a priced capability (see submit_job).

quote_id.description: The quote_id from POST /v1/jobs; required when priced.
